text:
maya: Hey — first day! quick Q: where do y'all put "ramp notes" for product teams? I made a Notion page in my personal workspace but sounds like there are team canonical spots. Also how do I get edit access to the platform docs (I only have view atm).

sam: welcome 🎉. Put ramp notes under the team space -> product/ramp-notes, not personal workspace. we keep them there so SEs can link to them.

maya: got it, thanks. can someone add me to editors for product/ramp-notes?

alex: tagging — @sam can you add maya to the editors group? the canonical path is https://redwood.notion.so/Product-Ramp-Notes-4b2f (read-only to org for now).

sam: sure. can you DM me the exact page URL or paste it here if it's the one you already made? I can add you to the "product-editors" group.

maya: pasted: https://redwood.notion.so/maya/quick-ramp-1234 (it's the one i started). i moved a few bits under the template but didn't publish.

alex: quick note on structure — use the team template: Product > Onboarding > Ramp note (Template). keep sections: TL;DR, Goals, Oncall contacts, Env setup, Links. helps later when ops automations extract links.

luis: also fyi, new hires should fill the "first-week checklist" under People Ops > New Hires, that triggers access requests automatically for some docs. if that didn't fire for you i can kick it off.

maya: i did the checklist but maybe missed the doc permission toggle. would appreciate if you could kick it luis.

devex-bot: @sam added @maya to group "product-editors" (role: editor) — changed pages: Product/Ramp-Notes access updated.

maya: sweet, i can edit now. one tiny question: any shortcuts for duplicating the template without breaking the page IDs? i always end up renaming a bunch of properties.

alex: best workflow: open the template, click "Duplicate", then move the duplicate into Product > Onboarding. edit only the title and the frontmatter properties. avoid copy-pasting entire blocks between pages if you want the automations to keep working.

sam: if you want i'll run a 10-min walkthrough in the afternoon (screenshare) — show the template fields + tagging conventions.

maya: yes please — 2pm works. thanks y'all! :smile:

luis: added the auto-access trigger for Product docs just in case — you should keep edits smooth now.

maya: confirmed i can see the page and edit. closing the loop. thanks!!! :raised_hands:
